Class Policy

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.rl.Policy
public final class Policy extends Object
Maths for the factorised categorical policy: sampling, log-probabilities, entropy, gradients.

      public static void softmax(float[] logits, int off, int n, float[] probs)

    • pushSwing

      public static void pushSwing(float[] logits, float bias)
      Adds bias to the swing's logit: the answer rule as a push the network learns on top of (Config.answerNudge), instead of a swing made for it that it never hears of.

    • evaluate

      public static float evaluate(float[] logits, int headMask, byte[] action, float[] probsOut, float[] entropyOut)
      Evaluates stored actions under the current logits.
      Parameters:
      probsOut - receives the softmax of every unlocked head
      entropyOut - receives the per-head entropy (0 for locked heads); length HEADS
      Returns:
      log pi(action | obs) summed over the unlocked heads

    • allProbs

      public static void allProbs(float[] logits, float[] probs)
      Softmax of every head's logits into probs, whatever the mask: for a network's choices kept to be compared with later (kl(int, float[], float[])).

    • kl

      public static float kl(int headMask, float[] anchorProbs, float[] probs)
      KL(anchor || current) summed over the unlocked heads.
      Parameters:
      anchorProbs - the anchor's choices (allProbs(float[], float[]))
      probs - the current network's, from evaluate(float[], int, byte[], float[], float[]) on the same state

    • gradient

      public static void gradient(int headMask, byte[] action, float[] probs, float[] entropy, float dLogp, float[] entCoef, float[] dLogits)
      Writes dLoss/dLogits for loss = dLogp * logp - sum_h entCoef[h] * entropy_h. probs and entropy must come from evaluate(float[], int, byte[], float[], float[]) on the same logits.
